'''''Fate of the Jedi: Omen''''' is a novel by [[Christie Golden]] released on [[June 23]], [[2009]]. It is the second novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series and published as a hardcover. It was originally going to be titled '''''Enigma''''', but the title was changed to better fit with the story.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=07245#17383813|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-01|time=4:35 PM|quote=today we all decided that the title OMEN fits FoTJ #2 much better than ENIGMA, so we changed it.}}</ref> At the end of the book, it has an introduction to ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''. The audio version is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback was released on [[May 25]], [[2010]].<ref name="Sue">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=270737&start=645|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs 3.0|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|check=1}}</ref>
